aim_comparison.result: Uniform affine reverse Faber-Krahn bound, Gaussian-position bound, and information-dependent Dirichlet upper bound.
aim_comparison.reason: The old reverse Faber-Krahn subject occurs only in the historical editorial record for 106. Current AIM 106 is the all-index Payne Dirichlet-buckling comparison on the same domain, which the affine first-Dirichlet-eigenvalue theorem does not assert. M03 assumes a Poincare bound and concludes an eigenvalue bound; it does not prove AIM 092 KLS. It has no compact-manifold score-gradient approximation conclusion for retained AIM 665. Magnetic Neumann optimization, sharp inradius lower bounds and sharp torsion-eigenvalue constants are also different statements.
